text: bend_curvature recalibration falsified -- draw residual is low-leverage calibration bend_curvature draw negative-result residual-queue residual-queue #1 (draw over-weighted t=-17.4) is not fixed by bend_curvature. subsample sweep nominated 0.0030 (48->50%) but at full scale 0.0030 gives 47.9% vs 0.0037's 47.7% (+0.2pp, within noise) and ece worse (0.0087 vs 0.0074). %market is on a flat ridge over bend in [0.0030,0.0050] -- the geometry knob is already near-optimal. interpretation: the draw residual is real but low-leverage for goodness-of-fit (it shifts mid-pack mass, not the winner's prob, which dominates %market). keep bend_curvature(st)=0.0037. next: re-diagnose and target a higher-leverage mechanism (w_prime t=+12.9 or mass t=+9.0), or test a draw x distance/field interaction rather than the flat bend constant.
